teaser.en: The 'male climber', though it doesn't really climb, and nobody could say why it counts as male.
teaser.sw: 'Mtambaaji dume', ingawa kwa kweli hautambai, na hakuna aliyeweza kueleza kwa nini unahesabiwa kuwa dume.
teaser.dg: 'Mbugu ya chilume', hata kala taikpwera kpwa kpweli, na takuna ariyeweza kugomba kpwa nini inaonwa kukala ni ya chilume.

summary.en: *Chibugu chilume* is a small wild indigo that Digo count as the male partner of the climber *chibugu*. Even the people who use the name couldn't explain why.
summary.sw: *Chibugu chilume* ni mmea mdogo wa porini wa jamii ya nili ambao Wadigo huuhesabu kuwa mwenzi dume wa mtambaaji *chibugu*. Hata wanaotumia jina hilo hawakuweza kueleza sababu yake.
summary.dg: *Chibugu chilume* ni *indigo* ndide ya weruni ambayo Adigo anaiona dza mlume wa *chibugu*, mmea unaokpwera. Hata atu anaohumira dzina hiri taaweza kueleza kpwa nini.

about.en: *Indigofera trita* is a small herb or sub-shrub of the pea family with pinnate leaves of three to five small leaflets, flattened grey hairs, and short spikes of small red to pink flowers. Its pods are slender, straight and pointed. Pakia classes it as a herb. Digo identify it by its leaves.
about.sw: *Indigofera trita* ni mmea mdogo au kichaka kidogo cha jamii ya kunde, chenye majani yaliyogawanyika kuwa vijani vidogo vitatu hadi vitano, manyoya bapa ya rangi ya kijivu, na vishada vifupi vya maua madogo mekundu hadi ya waridi. Maganda yake ni membamba, yaliyonyooka na yenye ncha. Pakia anauainisha kuwa mmea mdogo (herb). Wadigo huutambua kwa majani yake.
about.dg: *Indigofera trita* ni mmea mdide, au chitsaka chidide, wa jamii ya kunde. Makodzage ganagbwanyika kuhenda makodza madide mahahu hadi matsano, na una nyere ndide za rangi ya ivu zirizolala dzulu ya makodza, na milita mifupi ya maruwa madide ga kundu hadi ga pinki. Makakayage ni membamba, gasigofyuka, na genye ntsa. Pakia anauika kahi ya mimea midide laini. Adigo anaumanya kpwa makodzage.

where.en: It is widespread in grassland, bushland and old cultivation across tropical Africa and Asia.
where.sw: Unapatikana kwa wingi katika nyika za nyasi, vichakani na mashamba ya zamani kote katika maeneo ya tropiki ya Afrika na Asia.
where.dg: Unaphahikana sana phatu pha nyasi, weruni na kpwenye minda iriyorichwa, kosi Afrika ya tsi za dzoho na Asia.

culture.en: *Chilume* means 'male'. Digo often name plants in male and female pairs, and this species is the male form of *chibugu* (*Rhynchosia velutina*). Pakia notes that the reason it is thought of as male is not clear.
culture.sw: *Chilume* maana yake ni 'dume'. Mara nyingi Wadigo hupa mimea majina kwa jozi za dume na jike, na spishi hii ndiyo umbo la dume la *chibugu* (*Rhynchosia velutina*). Pakia anaeleza kwamba sababu ya kuuona kuwa dume haiko wazi.
culture.dg: *Chilume* manage ni 'mlume'. Adigo mara nyinji anaiha mimea kpwa jozi za mlume na mchetu, na aina hino ni ya chilume ya *chibugu* (*Rhynchosia velutina*). Pakia anaandika kukala sababu ya kuonwa kukala ni mlume taimanyikana.

names.en: Pakia records *chibugu chilume*, 'male climber'. *Chibugu* is the small form of *mbugu*, 'climber'. No Swahili or English common name has been recorded.
names.sw: Pakia ameandika *chibugu chilume*, 'mtambaaji dume'. *Chibugu* ni umbo dogo la *mbugu*, 'mtambaaji'. Hakuna jina la kawaida la Kiswahili wala la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *chibugu chilume*, 'mbugu ya chilume'. *Chibugu* ni dzina ra udide ra *mbugu*, 'mmea unaokpwera'. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili wala ra Chingereza ririroandikpwa.
